extraction.name: TextVQA
extraction.description: TextVQA contains 45,336 questions on 28,408 images that require reasoning about text to answer.
extraction.creator: Amanpreet Singh, Vivek Natarajan, Meet Shah, Yu Jiang, Xinlei Chen, Dhruv Batra, Devi Parikh, Marcus Rohrbach
extraction.citeAs: Singh, A., Natarajan, V., Shah, M., Jiang, Y., Chen, X., Batra, D., Parikh, D., & Rohrbach, M. (2019). Towards VQA Models That Can Read. arXiv:1904.08920v2.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: A three stage pipeline for crowd-sourcing data. Stage 1: Annotators identified images that did not contain text. Stage 2: Annotators provided 1-2 questions per image requiring reading text. Stage 3: Annotators provided 10 answers per question.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator, Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: In some cases, when the OCR system is unable to detect text we get 0 tokens but those cases are restricted to ~1.5k images and we manually verified that the images actually do contain text.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were sampled from Open Images categories weighted by the average number of OCR boxes per category. Images identified as not containing text were filtered out.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators were asked to provide a question which requires reading the text in the image to answer. For a second question, they were shown the first question and asked to come up with a question that requires reasoning about the text and has a different answer. 10 answers were collected for each question. Annotators could flag questions as: no text in image, not a question, answering doesn't require reading text, or unanswerable. Questions with majority flags were removed.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All 10 annotators agree on the most common answer for 22.8% questions, while 3 or more annotators agree on most common answer for 97.9% questions.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Addresses the problem that current VQA models cannot read, which is a dominant class of questions asked by visually impaired users on images of their surroundings.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Most questions start with 'what'. The model often answers questions about cities with 'new york' indicating a potential bias. Yes/no questions make up only 5.55% of the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: 8.9% of the TextVQA questions can only be answered by combining multiple OCR tokens, which the proposed model cannot do. The OCR model fails at detecting text that is rotated, unstructured, or partially occluded. The model has a strong dependency on the quality of OCR tokens.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Benchmarking VQA models that can read
